repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform
repos.summary_zh: LlamaIndex 是一个领先的文档智能代理与 OCR 平台，专为构建基于大模型的文档应用而设计。它提供数据连接、索引、查询与可视化能力，支持多模态输入与复杂推理，广泛应用于知识库问答、文档分析与智能检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: LlamaIndex is a leading document agent and OCR platform designed for building LLM-powered document applications. It enables data ingestion, indexing, querying, and visualization, supporting multimodal inputs and complex reasoning for use cases like knowledge base QA, document analysis, and intelligent retrieval.

repos.description: Use Claude Code as the foundation for coding infrastructure, allowing you to decide how to interact with the model while enjoying updates from Anthropic.
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code Router 是基于 Claude Code 构建的智能编码基础设施，支持多模型路由、动态切换及请求/响应转换，兼容 OpenRouter、DeepSeek、Ollama 等主流 AI 模型提供商，提供 CLI 管理和 GitHub Actions 集成，适用于复杂编码场景下的灵活 AI 工具编排。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Router builds on Claude Code to enable intelligent coding infrastructure with multi-model routing, dynamic switching, and request/response transformation. It supports providers like OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and Ollama, offering CLI management and GitHub Actions integration for flexible AI tool orchestration in complex development workflows.

repos.description: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
repos.summary_zh: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: GUI for ChatGPT API and many LLMs. Supports agents, file-based QA, GPT finetuning and query with web search. All with a neat UI.
repos.summary_zh: 川虎 Chat 是一款为 ChatGPT 等多种大语言模型设计的轻量级 Web GUI，支持多模态 API、本地部署模型及 Agent 助理。提供文件问答、微调训练、联网搜索等功能，配备现代化毛玻璃 UI 和移动端适配，并支持历史记录管理与 PWA 安装。
repos.summary_en: Chuanhu Chat is a lightweight web GUI for ChatGPT and other LLMs, supporting multiple APIs, local models, agents, file-based QA, fine-tuning, and web search. Features a modern UI with glassmorphism, mobile support, history management, and PWA installation.

repos.description: Private & local AI personal knowledge management app for high entropy people.
repos.summary_zh: Reor 是一款本地运行的 AI 个人知识管理应用，专为高信息密度人群设计。它基于 Ollama、Transformers.js 和 LanceDB 构建，支持自动关联笔记、语义搜索与 LLM 驱动的问答。所有数据本地存储，提供类 Obsidian 的 Markdown 编辑器，通过向量数据库实现智能内容检索与思维增强。
repos.summary_en: Reor is a private, local AI-powered personal knowledge management app for high-entropy individuals. Built on Ollama, Transformers.js, and LanceDB, it enables automatic note linking, semantic search, and LLM-based Q&A via RAG. All data stays local with an Obsidian-like markdown editor, offering intelligent context retrieval to augment thought.

repos.description: Use your locally running AI models to assist you in your web browsing
repos.summary_zh: Page Assist 是一款开源浏览器扩展，通过本地运行 AI 模型（如 Ollama）为网页浏览提供智能助手功能。支持 Chrome、Firefox 等主流浏览器，具备侧边栏交互和独立 Web UI 两种使用方式，用户可直接在任意网页中与本地 AI 对话，实现网页内容问答与知识提取。
repos.summary_en: Page Assist is an open-source browser extension that enables interaction with locally running AI models (e.g., via Ollama) directly from any webpage. It offers a sidebar and standalone web UI for Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Firefox, and Edge, allowing users to chat with webpage content using their own AI model.

repos.description: Open-source Claude Design alternative. One-click import your Claude Code / Codex API key. Prompt → prototype / slides / PDF. Multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama). BYOK, local-first, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Open CoDesign 是一款开源的 Claude Design 替代工具，支持一键导入 Claude Code/Codex API 密钥，将提示词转换为原型、幻灯片或 PDF。支持多模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini/Kimi/GLM/Ollama），采用 BYOK 和本地优先架构，MIT 许可，适合 AI 驱动的设计自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Open CoDesign is an open-source alternative to Claude Design that converts prompts into polished prototypes, slides, or PDFs using your own API keys. Supports multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama), BYOK, and local-first architecture with MIT license for AI-powered design automation.

repos.description: Repo for BenTsao [original name: HuaTuo (华驼)], Instruction-tuning Large Language Models with Chinese Medical Knowledge. 本草（原名：华驼）模型仓库，基于中文医学知识的大语言模型指令微调
repos.summary_zh: 本草（原名华驼）开源基于中文医学知识指令微调的LLaMA、Alpaca-Chinese、Bloom、活字等模型，采用LoRA方法在医学知识库与文献数据上训练，显著提升医疗问答效果，支持多基模型适配与推理部署。
repos.summary_en: BenTsao (formerly HuaTuo) is an open-source collection of instruction-tuned large language models including LLaMA, Alpaca-Chinese, Bloom, and Huozi, fine-tuned on Chinese medical knowledge using LoRA. It enhances medical Q&A performance across multiple base models with support for inference deployment.

repos.description: AI 影视生产级工具 | 支持 Seedance 2.0 | 剧本到成片全流程批量化 | AI-powered film production tool with Seedance 2.0 support
repos.summary_zh: 魔因漫创是一款AI影视生产级工具，支持Seedance 2.0多模态生成，实现从剧本解析、角色场景生成到分镜制作与成片输出的全流程自动化。具备角色一致性管理、批量化生产队列、多供应商AI调度等核心能力，专为短剧、动漫番剧等中高频内容创作场景设计。
repos.summary_en: Moyin Creator is an AI-powered film production tool supporting Seedance 2.0 for end-to-end automation from script parsing to final video generation. It features character consistency, batch processing, and multi-provider AI scheduling, optimized for short-form dramas and anime series.

repos.description: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
repos.summary_zh: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
repos.summary_en: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI 是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术的智能对话系统，支持多格式文档管理与向量化处理，提供精准知识问答服务。系统具备前后端分离架构、分布式文件存储及高性能向量数据库（如 ChromaDB、Qdrant），支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek 及本地 Ollama 模型部署，适用于私有化部署与 API 集成场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, enabling precise knowledge-based Q&A through document retrieval and LLM integration. It supports multi-format document ingestion, asynchronous processing, vectorization, and flexible LLM deployment (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), with a scalable backend architecture and OpenAPI for external access.

repos.description: 这是一个用于监控和检测 Ollama 服务可用性和性能的系统。它提供了一个现代化的 Web 界面，支持多语言（中文/英文），并具有实时检测和数据展示功能。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个专为 Ollama 服务设计的现代化监控系统，提供实时可用性检测、性能监控（响应时间/TPS）和模型状态展示。支持多语言界面、批量服务检测、FOFA 扫描及数据导出功能，采用 Next.js 14 + TypeScript 构建，具备响应式设计和国际化能力。
repos.summary_en: A modern monitoring system for Ollama services that provides real-time availability detection, performance metrics (response time/TPS), and model status tracking. Features multi-language support, batch service scanning, FOFA integration, data export, and a responsive web interface built with Next.js 14 and TypeScript.

repos.description: Ollama to OpenAI compatible API gateway — multi-backend load balancing, health check, auto discovery
repos.summary_zh: Ollama2API 是一个将多个 Ollama 实例聚合为统一 OpenAI 兼容 API 的网关，支持多节点负载均衡、自动健康检查与批量扫描发现。提供 Web 管理后台、API Key 鉴权、代理集成及流式响应，零依赖 JSON 存储，适用于 AI 模型集群管理与自动化运维。
repos.summary_en: Ollama2API is a gateway that aggregates multiple Ollama instances into a unified OpenAI-compatible API, featuring multi-node load balancing, automatic health checks, and batch node discovery. It includes a web admin panel, API key authentication, proxy support, and streaming responses, using zero-dependency JSON storage for easy deployment in AI model cluster management.

repos.description: This is a simple ollama admin panel that implements a list of models to download models and a dialog function.
repos.summary_zh: Ollama Manager 是一个简洁的 Ollama 模型管理面板，支持模型列表展示、搜索与下载功能，并提供基础对话交互界面。基于 Wails 框架开发，采用 GoEasyDesigner 设计界面，提供 Windows 和 macOS 跨平台支持，适用于本地大模型部署与管理的轻量化工具。
repos.summary_en: Ollama Manager is a lightweight admin panel for managing Ollama models, featuring model listing, search, download, and basic chat functionality. Built with Wails and designed via GoEasyDesigner, it supports cross-platform deployment on Windows and macOS, serving as an efficient local tool for LLM deployment and interaction.
